sents.t: I don't know why dolphins even sound like that.
sents.zh: 我真不明白海豚怎么会发出那样的声音。

bkw: 在哪里；从哪里（用于提问）

sents.t: I beat a guy at cards there once.
sents.zh: 我以前在那里跟一个人打牌，还赢了他。

sents.t: You've been to the surface and done the change?
sents.zh: 你去过水面上，还变过身？

sents.t: Yeah? Well, the curious fish gets caught.
sents.zh: 是吗？好奇的鱼可是会被抓住的。

cards.ex: Even adds emphasis to something surprising. Here, it shows that the speaker finds the sound strange.
exs: Why do dolphins even make that sound?
cards.note: Day 2 原句：“I don't know why dolphins even sound like that.”（我真不明白海豚怎么会发出那样的声音。）

cards.ex: Your mind is the part of you that thinks and feels. “What is on your mind?” asks what you are thinking about.
exs: You look quiet. What is on your mind?
cards.note: Day 2 原句：“What's on your mind?”（你在想什么呢？）

cards.zh: 在哪里；从哪里（用于提问）
cards.ex: “Where do” begins a question about a place. Use it with I, you, we, they, or a plural noun, followed by the base form of a verb.
exs: Where do these boats go at night?
cards.note: Day 2 原句：“Where do boats come from?”（那些船是从哪里来的？）

cards.ex: Above means in a higher place than something else. Above the surface means higher than the top of the water.
exs: A small boat floated above the sea monsters.
cards.note: Day 2 原句：“Just above the surface.”（就在水面上方。） 上一句 The land monster town 指“陆怪的城镇”。

cards.ex: Cards are small pieces of thick paper used to play games. To beat someone at cards means to win a card game against them.
exs: Grandma likes playing cards with her friends.
cards.note: Day 2 原句：“I beat a guy at cards there once.”（我以前在那里跟一个人打牌，还赢了他。）

cards.ex: A change is when something becomes different. In this story, the change is turning from a sea monster into a human.
exs: Luca was surprised by the change in his body.
cards.note: Day 2 原句：“You've been to the surface and done the change?”（你去过水面上，还变过身？）

cards.ex: Curious means wanting to know or learn more about something. A curious person asks questions and explores new things.
exs: Luca is curious about the world above the water.
cards.note: Day 2 原句：“I was just curious.”（我只是好奇而已。） 另一原句：“Yeah? Well, the curious fish gets caught.”（是吗？好奇的鱼可是会被抓住的。）

items.s: I don't know why dolphins ___ sound like that.
items.why: even 在这里加强语气，表示觉得海豚的声音很奇怪；不是形容词“平坦的”。
items.ft: I don't know why dolphins even sound like that.

items.why: on your mind 表示“在你心里、让你惦记着”，这里 mind 是名词。
boats 是复数，后面 come 是实义动词，问地点时用 Where do；单数主语通常用 Where does。
above 是介词，后面接 the surface，表示“在水面上方”。本题练方位词，不是强行变词形。

items.s: I beat a guy at ___ there once.
items.why: at cards 是“打牌”这个活动的固定说法。cards 是复数，不是一张牌。
items.ft: I beat a guy at cards there once.

items.s: You've been to the surface and done the ___?
items.why: the 后面用名词 change。done the change 在电影里指完成从海怪到人类的变身，不是“找零钱”。
items.ft: You've been to the surface and done the change?

items.why: was 后面用形容词 curious 描述“我”当时的状态。just 是“只是”，修饰 curious。

where do: 问地点；搭配复数主语等
问地点；搭配第三人称单数主语
